```{r}
str(book)
str(shop)

book <- factor(book, levels = c("romance", "crime", "science fiction"))
shop <- factor(shop, levels = c("shop1", "shop2"))

book_shop <- table(book, shop)
book_shop
prop.table(book_shop, margin = 2)

result <- chisq.test(book_shop)
result
result$expected
result$stdres

# If the expected-count condition is inadequate:
chisq.test(book_shop, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
```

```{r}
library(psych)

autonom <- job_data[
  c("autonom1", "autonom2", "autonom3", "autonom4")
]

alpha_result <- psych::alpha(
  autonom,
  check.keys = TRUE,
  warnings = FALSE
)

alpha_result$total
alpha_result$keys
alpha_result$item.stats[, "r.drop", drop = FALSE]
alpha_result$alpha.drop[, "raw_alpha", drop = FALSE]
```
